excerpt: Circulaire de procuration de Newell Brands déposée à la SEC le 2026-03-26 (en anglais), élection des administrateurs et indépendance : « The Board has selected the following eight nominees for election to the Board » ; « the Board affirmatively determined that all of the Company’s current non-management directors are, and, during their service on the Board in 2025, were “independent” of the Company and its management within the meaning of the applicable Nasdaq rules » ; « Mr. Peterson is not considered an independent director nominee » ; calcul : (8 − 1) / 8 = 87,5 % (le PDG est le seul candidat non indépendant).
